reason: Amends MK oath in Basic Law: The Knesset to require allegiance to Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; adds Jewish identity to constitutional oath.
Gives Declaration of Independence Basic Law status, entrenching its full-equality guarantee as counterweight to Nation-State Law; balances rather than strengthens Jewish preference.
Repeals Basic Law: Nation-State of the Jewish People outright, removing the main constitutional entrenchment of Jewish character and restoring Arabic's official status.
Adds 'according to halakha' to Law of Return conversion clause, entrenching Orthodox definition of Jewishness; mainly intra-Jewish religion-state issue, not non-Jew equality.
Makes the Declaration, including its equality principle, the supreme interpretive source of all Basic Laws, entrenched by two-thirds; constrains Nation-State Law rather than strengthening it.
